label: Authority state machine
proposal: Artifacts can remain genealogically preserved while canonical, empirical, field-defining, or controlling authority changes.
claim_ceiling: Instrument target only; the researcher memo is not source evidence.

label: Field manuscripts as compilers
proposal: Later field manuscripts may retrospectively type earlier essays into context-relative operator roles.
claim_ceiling: Latent and retroactive architecture remain competing, compatible hypotheses.

label: Claim-evidence tomography
proposal: Formalization can independently change evidence, scope, falsifier granularity, and authority.
claim_ceiling: No composite rigor score and no assumption that more evidence narrows scope.

label: Canon maps as time-indexed builds
proposal: Canon Maps may be descriptive, prescriptive, or hybrid build checkpoints rather than interchangeable censuses.
claim_ceiling: Classify clause speech acts before comparing declared and reconstructed graphs.

label: Ordinal namespace problem
proposal: Repeated ordinals may belong to unresolved series namespaces rather than constituting numbering errors.
claim_ceiling: Never invent a predecessor or namespace.

label: Retrospectively compiled six-state sequence
proposal: A six-stage Detestable Subject sequence may have been compiled after its constituent artifacts.
claim_ceiling: Original sequence status requires exact source-span evidence.

label: Representation/compression lineage
proposal: The first structural appearance of observation, classification, compression, representation, decision, action, and feedback should be dated independently of keywords.
claim_ceiling: Similarity cannot establish external provenance.

label: Denominator of inquiry
proposal: Visible research may be a selected projection of possible, selected, studied, published, indexed, and retrieved inquiry states.
claim_ceiling: A current field development and earlier internal ancestry remain unresolved.

label: Epistemic surface-withdrawal assay
proposal: Corpus resilience can be decomposed after removing each platform into identity, text, chronology, relations, lineage, provenance, and authority recovery.
claim_ceiling: Availability loss is not suppression.

label: Phase-conditioned surface translation
proposal: Substack-to-Zenodo retitles may be concentrated in a publishing regime rather than expressing a universal corpus operator.
claim_ceiling: Intentional translation requires body-level evidence; title direction alone is descriptive.

label: SR self-perception assay
proposal: Declared self-models C_t may lag, anticipate, or differ from the relations reconstructible from contemporaneous artifacts G_t.
claim_ceiling: Constitutions are not judged as censuses.

label: Epistemic-object lifecycle
proposal: Origin Gravity, recurrence, governance, canon formation, lineage, authority, and Legacy may describe phases of an intellectual object's lifecycle.
claim_ceiling: No seven-part mapping is forced.

label: Narrative-to-formal representation lift
proposal: Narrative or intuitive precursors may be lifted into theorem, law, empirical, or operational representations with measurable semantic and claim transformation.
claim_ceiling: Formalization may preserve, narrow, inflate, or change claims.

label: Route-conditioned retrieval
proposal: START HERE and read-next routes may deliver different conceptual states to the same endpoint.
claim_ceiling: Navigation and conceptual graphs remain separate.

label: Typed companion cycles
proposal: Reciprocal relations may be legitimate across different predicates while each same-predicate historical or conceptual graph remains acyclic.
claim_ceiling: Unlike predicates are never blended into a cycle.

label: Minimal epistemic state vector
proposal: Existence, visibility, retrievability, provenance, lineage, and authority may form a useful non-collapsed state vector for observed corpus transformations.
claim_ceiling: The archive must test this model against simpler alternatives.

label: Promissory topology
proposal: Forward-declared expected objects may be compiled before their public manifestation and later resolve exactly, renamed, scope-changed, multiply, or not at all.
claim_ceiling: Missing objects remain open unless abandonment or a closed observation window is witnessed.

label: Architecture-relative role assignment
proposal: A work's role is rho(work | architecture, scope, time), not an intrinsic property.
claim_ceiling: Source self-description and retrospective typing are separate assertions.

label: Authority jurisdiction tomography
proposal: Canonical entry, reference, constitutional, empirical, field-defining, and controlling authority may have different scopes rather than one throne.
claim_ceiling: No latest-wins inference and no supersession without a witnessed edge.

label: Polycompilation
proposal: Overlapping source sets may be compiled into multiple coexisting build targets with different role assignments and claim transformations.
claim_ceiling: Coexistence is not equivalence and later builds do not erase earlier builds.

label: Compiler conservation
proposal: Compilers may preserve, narrow, expand, rename, reinterpret, demote, or omit source claims.
claim_ceiling: Transformation is assessed dimension by dimension.

label: Evidence multiplicity non-collapse
proposal: Multiple papers, representations, or authority assertions may share one underlying evidence unit.
claim_ceiling: No paper counts as independent confirmation until evidence lineage is distinguished.

label: Multi-order temporal structure
proposal: Historical, conceptual, navigational, operational, manifestation, and compiler orders may lawfully invert.
claim_ceiling: Cross-order inversion is not an automatic contradiction.

label: Referential integrity assay
proposal: Source bibliography, semantic-body lineage, and archive reconstruction may disagree, including DOI/title cross-swaps.
claim_ceiling: Source errors remain preserved and unrepaired.

label: Publishing-regime state machine
proposal: The distribution of publication relation and representation types may have bounded change points over time.
claim_ceiling: Report exploratory unless preregistered coverage, bootstrap, and held-out thresholds pass.

label: Conceptual DAG falsification
proposal: The source-declared conceptual DAG claim can be tested using only source-witnessed conceptual dependency predicates.
claim_ceiling: No cycle only means survives captured scope.
